question: What is our return rate and which categories are worst?
sql:
SELECT
  p.category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(o.status = 'Returned'), COUNT(*)), 4) AS return_rate
FROM s_order_items AS oi
JOIN s_orders   AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN s_products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
HAVING orders > 50
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 20
report: Return rate by category, with a volume floor so a category with a handful of orders cannot top the list on one return. Note the denominator here includes cancelled orders, so it is not on the same base as net revenue.
